data.one_liner: Flutter widget for selectable tree structures with RTL support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a tree view where users can select nodes, with optional multi‑select and drag‑and‑drop reordering. Supports right‑to‑left layouts and configurable data sources.
use_when: You need a hierarchical list with selectable items
You require drag‑and‑drop reordering of tree nodes
Your UI must support RTL languages
avoid_when: You need massive data sets with virtual scrolling
You require highly custom node rendering beyond provided config
strengths: RTL support out of the box
Simple API for list or map data sources
weaknesses: No virtualized scrolling for large trees
No code‑generation or advanced state management integration
